title: H3UI construction and ownership
description: H3UI normally produces ordinary OpenMW layouts. Recipes that create nested Elements are the exception and require an explicit child scope.

nodes.title: H3UI constructor call
nodes.detail: Application code uses one public constructor surface for components and recipes.

nodes.title: Recipe expansion
nodes.detail: Higher-level recipes expand only when the resolver needs them.

nodes.title: Semantic component specs
nodes.detail: The resolver preserves component and recipe identity for styling and mutation.

nodes.title: Style resolution
nodes.detail: Themes turn semantic roles, variants, tones, and classes into concrete styles.

nodes.title: H3 component builders
nodes.detail: Builders produce layouts without owning the caller's mounted root.

nodes.title: openmw.ui.Layout
nodes.detail: The normal result is still an ordinary OpenMW layout.

nodes.title: Caller ui.create(...)
nodes.detail: Application code chooses the layer and creates the mounted root Element.

nodes.title: Caller-owned Element
nodes.detail: The caller owns the root Element lifetime, destruction, and application state.

nodes.title: scope.child()
nodes.detail: The application creates a child scope before invoking a recipe that owns a nested Element.

nodes.title: Nested ui.create(...)
nodes.detail: The isolated recipe creates its nested Element under the child scope.

nodes.title: Child-scope-owned Element
nodes.detail: The child scope destroys this nested Element recursively with its parent.
